summary: Dispatches a race/event message to a name- or attribute-lookup handler based on the event ID read from the state block at a2+12. A random flag v4 (RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() % 2) is computed up front and selects the random-string variant of SessionStringNameLookup for the first case group. Each case group routes to one of: SessionStringNameLookup (several groups, differing only in the final flag argument), sub_412490, sub_412E50, TextAttributeLookup, TextAttributeLookup_3710, or MapCollisionShapeToBoneIndex, always passing a4, a1, the value at a3+16, and 1 as fixed arguments. Unrecognized event IDs fall through to the default and return 0. Called by FontRenderingPrep.

local_names.a1: receiver/context argument passed through to every handler
local_names.a2: message/event state block whose +12 offset holds the event ID used for dispatch
local_names.a3: data block whose +16 offset value is passed through to every handler
local_names.a4: output/result argument passed through to every handler
local_names.v4: random flag (RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() % 2) selecting the random variant of SessionStringNameLookup

operations.description: Computes v4 = RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() % 2, the random flag used by the first case group's SessionStringNameLookup variant
Switch on the event ID read from *(a2 + 12), compiled through jump table jpt_411C29 and case table byte_411D6C; unrecognized IDs hit the default and return 0
Returns the result of whichever handler ran, or 0 for the default/unrecognized-ID path
Invoked by FontRenderingPrep (00411840) as part of the rendering/UI message pass
